extraction_notes: Complete water extraction: aggregate withdrawal/discharge/consumption 2021-2025; 2025 data-centre vs office split; per-location 2025 withdrawal/discharge/consumption (~36 sites); freshwater-at-risk shares (Google Water Risk Framework low/med/high); freshwater replenishment series and 2030 capacity/ambition; Gemini Apps median per-prompt water (0.26 mL). Google reports ALL THREE flows (withdrawal, discharge, consumption); consumption = withdrawal - discharge. Water potable unless noted. Not GCP-attributed. Data-centre risk uses Google's own Water Risk Framework; offices use WRI Aqueduct + WWF.
